description: Frozen legacy baseline for ORBRunner. Do not modify. All new runs use agents/orb_strategy.py with ORBStrategyConfig.
known_defects: Signal freshness not enforced — stale bars can trigger entries
Duplicate bar timestamps not filtered — can double-fire signals
Intrabar conflict resolves target-first (optimistic) — should be stop-first (conservative)
Strike selection is asymmetric: puts use ATM+offset instead of ATM−offset
Opening range end boundary is ambiguous — 09:35 bar can be both range and breakout
No explicit one-trade-per-symbol policy — relies on state dict key collision
Entry latency not modeled — fill assumed at signal bar close
Circuit breaker conflates daily loss streak with per-symbol trade count
